args.content_digest: Resolution 2025-09 ratified CC-7; TLG-FIN-22 measure (iii) covers Complex 4 climate-control suspension
args.content_summary: By Resolution 2025-09, Talvern's board unanimously (7-0) adopted and ratified Cost Containment Initiative CC-7, incorporating management memorandum TLG-FIN-22 by reference, whose measure (iii) expressly covers suspending active climate-control operations at Silo Complex 4 at Halden Junction (the Complex 4 climate-control shutdown). Combined, these documents establish that Talvern's board formally ratified the program under which Complex 4's climate control was taken offline.
